_comment: {{CLIENT_NAME}} critic labelled cases. Channel-level, shared across videos; one JSON object per line, appended at G7 (the client's review). Readers skip any line with a _comment key. Never edit or delete a past case; add a correcting case instead. The critic advises and does not gate until about 30 labelled cases agree with it. Case status: 'labelled' (the client's explicit ruling and exact words recorded) or 'development case' (incomplete; not counted toward the 30). Lines with source 'yuvraj' or the operator's id are the operator's rulings from the AEM review inbox, not the client's.

fields.word_ids: word IDs from data/words.json the shot is placed on
fields.render_sha256: SHA-256 of the exact render that was reviewed
fields.frames_or_crops: paths of frames or crops showing the issue
fields.client_words: the client's exact words, verbatim; never paraphrased
fields.source: where the words came from (Frame.io CSV row, message), or the operator's id for an operator ruling
fields.critic_verdict_g5: the critic's G5 verdict on this shot, or null
